creationPrompt:
Create a service comparison for me as a Claw Me Page. Include compare the responsibility, questions before choosing, a sensible recommendation. Replace illustrative data, preserve relevant evidence and uncertainty, and check totals or percentages. Ask only for missing information in one concise batch: service options, exact inclusions, exclusions, client capabilities, timeline and pricing assumptions.

Use the Claw Me source at https://github.com/clawdotme/plugin in templates/service-comparison/index.html and templates/_shared/tailwind/README.md. Use semantic responsive HTML, working section links, and useful native details/summary interactions. No scripts, forms, tracking, or embedded frames in the static Page. Deliver matching HTML and PDF from the same content, expand disclosures for print, and inspect page breaks. Use a readable portrait PDF. PDF export is separate from Page publishing unless the current platform explicitly supports it.

exampleAnswers.Purpose and audience: Compare service packages by scope, responsibility, and fit rather than vague feature counts.
exampleAnswers.Working context: This fictional studio offers three engagement shapes. The comparison helps a client choose between a focused review, a guided sprint, and a complete website project. Prices are intentionally omitted until scope is known.
exampleAnswers.Example records:
Option: Review · Includes: One existing flow and written findings · Best fit: A team ready to make its own changes
Option: Sprint · Includes: Discovery and one tested direction · Best fit: An unclear problem with a deadline
Option: Website · Includes: Five-page design, build, and handover · Best fit: A business launching its first site
exampleAnswers.Content decisions:
Compare the responsibility: In a review, the client implements the changes. A sprint produces a direction and supporting evidence. The website engagement includes implementation within a defined page scope.
Questions before choosing: Who can supply content? Who will approve the work? Is the deadline fixed? The answers can change the suitable engagement more than the number of features listed.
A sensible recommendation: For the café example, the website engagement fits because the owner needs a complete handover and has no internal build team. Revisit the recommendation if the client already has a reliable implementation partner.
exampleAnswers.Format and interaction: comparison layout; section navigation and expandable detail where useful; matching portrait document PDF.
exampleAnswers.Sharing and provenance: A hypothetical example informed by Claw Me’s small-team and Agent workflows. These are not Pete’s actual clients, finances, travel plans, research results, or commitments. Keep the real adaptation private until the owner chooses to share.
